supraorbital_contour.lateral_prominence: moderate extension beyond the lateral margins of the eyes

macro_zonal_melanin_distribution.regional_intensity_contrast: high contrast between dark-pigmented upper face/cheeks and light-colored graying hair on the chin and lower muzzle

pinna_silhouette.severe_cartilage_deformities: superior helix of the left ear is crumpled or folded downward

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: structural deformity or traumatic folding on the upper portion of the left pinna
other_distinctive_markers: masticated green vegetation (wadge) held in the mouth
